paragraphs: Mari: Rav Ḥama bar Mari; R. Yitzḥak bar Mari; Rabbah bar Mari; R. Tanḥum bar Mari. Yuḥasin copied Abba Mari under alef. In my opinion Mari is their name, like Abba Yose and Abba Ḥanan; I have therefore written them here.
